bank.prompt: Which Brisbane housing style was made much harder to build by an 1885 land-subdivision law?
bank.reveal: The 1885 Undue Subdivision of Land Prevention Act imposed minimum street frontages and effectively stopped most new terrace rows, helping explain why Brisbane has fewer terraces than Sydney or Melbourne.

source.title: Watson Terrace
source.verifierNote: The Council entry says the 1885 Act imposed minimum frontages that effectively prevented terrace-house construction.

bank.prompt: Fortitude Valley got its name from a ship that arrived in Brisbane in 1849. What was that ship called?
bank.reveal: Scottish immigrants aboard the barque Fortitude arrived at Brisbane in January 1849. Denied promised free land, they camped nearby — and named the area after their ship.

source.title: Fortitude Valley | Queensland Places
source.publisher: Centre for the Government of Queensland
source.verifierNote: Page states 'The first vessel, the Fortitude, arrived at Brisbane in January 1849' and 'The temporary abode gave rise to the name Fortitude Valley.'

bank.prompt: The suburb name 'Indooroopilly' comes from an Aboriginal word. What does it mean?
bank.reveal: Brisbane City Council's Heritage Trail explains the name comes from an Aboriginal word believed to mean a gully or creek with leeches — a nod to the leech-filled gullies once running to the Brisbane River.

source.title: Indooroopilly Heritage Trail | Brisbane City Council
source.verifierNote: Page states 'The name Indooroopilly is thought to come from an Aboriginal word. It is believed to mean a gully or creek with leeches.'
